outcome: detection of malignant transformation in ovarian endometriomas
cohort: 446 female patients undergoing MRI for suspected pelvic endometriosis, with an average age of 34.13 years.
finding: An abbreviated non-contrast MRI protocol demonstrates diagnostic accuracy comparable to that of a comprehensive protocol in detecting pelvic endometriosis, with similar confidence and reproducibility.
mod_finding: The MRI protocols showed perfect agreement for the detection of endometriosis in caesarean section scars.
